test_goal: Exercise a boolean subtraction whose target body was created by sheet thicken.
risk_summary: Generated offset/thicken side or cap topology can pass API status but produce invalid or geometrically wrong boolean output.

geometry.parameter_notes: Keep sheet thickness comfortably above topology tolerance, then sweep the cutter around side contact.

expected_behavior: The subtraction should return at least one valid body. Interior sample points and exact coordinate extrema should remain stable across near-contact variants.
notes: Use stable chain step ids so topo tracking and triage can name generated sheet/thicken topology.
